entities.summary: Taiwan is a sovereign nation in East Asia, Asia. Its capital is Taipei. Official languages include Mandarin Chinese (Standard Chinese). Government: Unitary semi-presidential republic. Population: approximately 23.9 million. Area: 36,197 km². Comprehensive index for Taiwan (ROC) covering aboriginal Austronesian peoples, Dutch Formosa (1624-1662), Koxinga/Zheng regime, Qing Dynasty incorporation, Japanese colonial rule (1895-1945), Retrocession to ROC 1945, 228 Incident 1947, KMT martial law (White Terror 1949-1987), Chiang Kai-shek retreat 1949, Taiwan Miracle, democratization 1987+, Lee Teng-hui native presidency, DPP-KMT alternation, cross-strait tensions, and de facto independence amid PRC claims.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Taiwan's democratization in 1987 led to a significant shift in its governance, resulting in increased political stability and economic growth. The country's population has grown from approximately 15 million in 1970 to over 23.9 million today.
